definitions.gloss: latest model; newest version; current model
definitions.explanation: The most recently released version of a product, especially cars, electronics, appliances, or other manufactured goods. Emphasizes that this is the most up-to-date version available.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}モデルが{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: The latest model has been released.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンの{最新|さいしん}モデルに{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I upgraded to the latest model of smartphone.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{最新|さいしん}モデルだけあって、{燃費|ねんぴ}も{安全性|あんぜんせい}も{大幅|おおはば}に{向上|こうじょう}している。
examples.english: As you'd expect from the latest model, both fuel efficiency and safety have improved significantly.

notes:
Composed of {最新|さいしん} (newest, latest) and モデル (model). Frequently used in consumer and technology contexts when discussing product releases, upgrades, and comparisons between generations of the same product line.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最新|さいしん}モデルに{買|か}い{替|か}える: to upgrade to the latest model
- {最新|さいしん}モデルが{登場|とうじょう}する: for the latest model to appear/launch
- {最新|さいしん}モデルの{機能|きのう}: features of the latest model
- {最新|さいしん}モデルを{試|ため}す: to try the latest model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新型|しんがた}: new model/type — often used for cars and official product designations
- {新製品|しんせいひん}: new product — broader term covering any newly released product
- {最新版|さいしんばん}: latest version/edition — used for software, books, and documents
